title: Const-ify dcerpc_sub_dissector structures.
description:
This moves about 56 kBytes of data from a read-write data section to read-only.

A preparatory commit makes pointers to dcerpc_sub_dissector suitably `const` everywhere... none of these pointers are ever used for writing.  The second commit, produced by a simple `sed` script, does the work of making each of the structures read-only throughout the codebase.  Note that many of these dissectors were auto-generated using pidl; They were _not_ re-generated as part of this commit, but the modification to the generator should be consistent with the modifications to the generated dissectors.

commits_data.title: Const-ify dcerpc_sub_dissector structures.
commits_data.message:
Const-ify dcerpc_sub_dissector structures.

This moves about 56 kBytes of data from a read-write data section to read-only.

The various dissectors were _not_ regenerated for this commit.  Instead, this
commit was produced using the following command:

   find * -type f -exec sed -i -e 's/\(["'\'']\|^\)static dcerpc_sub_dissector/\1static const dcerpc_sub_dissector/' \{\} \;

This updates the generator script and its test, as well as making an identical
change to all of the dissectors, regardless of whether or not those dissectors
were produced by the generator script.

commits_data.title: DCERPC: const-ify references to dcerpc_sub_dissector.
commits_data.message:
DCERPC: const-ify references to dcerpc_sub_dissector.

Allow for const-ification of dcerpc_sub_dissector structures by suitably
adorning pointers to dcerpc_sub_dissector with "const" when a routine does not
modify the structure.
